WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, ea.avg_humidity - aem.mean_humidity AS excess_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN all_equipment_mean aem
  WHERE aem.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > aem.mean_humidity
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT
  aa.equipref,
  aa.avg_humidity,
  aa.excess_humidity,
  aa.avg_humidity - gm.mean_humidity AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean gm
WHERE gm.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
